# Fleet-demo fixtures — demo-enhanced tier (W8)

**Status:** Generated by `scripts/generate_maritime_cyber_fixtures.py` (seed **42**).  
**Issue:** [indago#196](https://github.com/edgesentry/indago/issues/196)

## Disclosure

Same as [../README.md](../README.md): **synthetic** OT inventory + representative SBOM + **pinned** CVE subset. Not production or class-society data.

## Tier (scale-up-plan)

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Vessels | 12 |
| Physical assets / vessel | 6 |
| SBOM components / vessel | 25 |
| Expected hold | 6 |
| Expected pass | 6 |

## Regenerate

```bash
cd indago
uv run python scripts/generate_maritime_cyber_fixtures.py --seed 42 --verify
```

`--verify` runs `port_clearance_eval` for each vessel and writes `decision_hash` values into `manifest.json` (CI golden).

## Layout

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `manifest.json` | Vessel keys, expected/actual outcome, `decision_hash`, hold pattern |
| `asset_map.yaml` | Multi-asset OT bridge per vessel |
| `sbom/*.json` | CycloneDX per vessel |
| `cve/snapshot-fleet-demo.json` | Pinned OSV subset (Log4Shell + sample highs) |

## Profile

```bash
uv run python -m agents.port_clearance.run_clearance fleet-hold-01 \
  --profile-manifest profiles/maritime_cyber/fleet-demo-manifest.yaml \
  --skip-seal --skip-worm
```

PoC three-vessel fixtures under `fixtures/` (not `fleet-demo/`) remain the Cap Vista G1–G7 regression pack.

## Hold patterns

| Pattern | Vessels (typical) | Rules exercised |
|---------|-------------------|-----------------|
| `log4j_navigation_ecdis` | 4× `fleet-hold-*` | SG-CC-001, SG-CC-002, SG-CC-007 |
| `sbom_missing_supplier` | 1× | SG-CC-003 |
| `asset_map_missing_zone` | 1× | SG-CC-006 |
| `pass` | 6× `fleet-pass-*` | (none) |
